result.title: KolTa: A Physics-Informed Active Learning Framework for Formulation Discovery with Limited Data
result.comment: 21 pages, including 11 pages of supplementary material; 4 figures
result.summary: Finding high-performing formulations is difficult when few have been measured and experimental budgets are limited. We propose KolTa, an active learning framework that selects batches to discover the top 5% of formulations at a target temperature under a fixed query budget. KolTa combines a three-stage predictor of component contributions, role-conditioned interactions, and anchored temperature response with task-specific soft physics constraints. Its Physics-Residual-Calibrated Upper Confidence Bound (PRC-UCB) acquisition rule combines predicted utility, ensemble disagreement, and a target-temperature physics residual, with nonnegative exploration weights fitted to out-of-fold signed errors. We evaluate the framework on three measured tasks and one simulated task covering binary-mixture viscosity, drug solubility, ionic-liquid viscosity, and electrolyte conductivity. KolTa ranks first or second in mean area under the learning curve (AULC) on every task and outperforms seven of the eight comparator strategies in paired tests, winning 75 of 78 paired comparisons across tasks and seeds against those seven strategies. Across the three measured tasks, its largest gap to the best mean AULC is 0.032, compared with at least 0.056 for every comparator. On Drug, reaching 80% average recovery of the remaining targets across drugs requires an estimated median of 348 additional formulation queries, about 18% fewer than the fastest comparator. Researchers can adapt the framework to diverse formulation problems through component roles and physical constraints.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 KolTa 主动学习框架，用三阶段预测器结合软物理约束，并以融合预测效用、集成分歧与物理残差的 PRC-UCB 规则在固定查询预算下批量挑选配方，以找出目标温度下前 5% 的高性能配方。
AI.relevance_reason: 固定预算下的批式证据选择、分歧驱动探索与残差校准评分，可能为 LVR 中「何时继续 LOOK、何时 STOP」及视觉证据筛选与获取成本权衡提供可核查的借鉴；但该工作属材料配方发现，与多模态推理无直接联系。
